sources.title: 3MF Core Specification & Reference Guide
sources.version_or_commit: Published Core Specification v1.4.0 (change history dated 2025-02-06); live master page did not surface a commit hash.
sources.locator: Sections 1.1-2.1 (OPC/ZIP, parts, thumbnails, PrintTicket); 2.2.1-2.2.2 (recommended/reserved double extensions); 3.1-3.4 (unit, transforms, metadata); 4.2 (components); 5.1 (base materials); 6.1-6.2 (thumbnail/core properties); 2.3.2-2.3.3 (extension behavior).
sources.observed_operation: Read-only browser open/find of the official 3MF Consortium specification; inspected the relevant sections. No implementation or package was run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: 3MF is an OPC ZIP package. Model unit defaults to millimeter; declared alternatives are micron, centimeter, inch, foot and meter. Components reference objects and transforms; manufacturing devices must preserve their relative position. Base-material names convey portable design intent; PrintTicket maps to a consumer environment. Package thumbnail and Description metadata are optional. Core v1.4.0 recommends purpose-signalling suffixes such as .model.3mf and .project.3mf. Unsupported extension data may be ignored; producers should avoid requiring extensions unless key meaning depends on them.
sources.applicability: Format-level normative/recommended behavior only; does not guarantee a specific exporter or receiver writes, displays or preserves optional fields, extensions, names or project settings.

sources.title: PrusaSlicer issue #8998: STEP import excludes big chunk of part
sources.version_or_commit: Opened 2022-10-03 against PrusaSlicer 2.5.0. Sep 18 2026 follow-up says it reproduced on whatever Flathub beta version was installed that day; exact build is not named.
sources.locator: Description/repro and 2.5.0 version (lines 151-188); maintainer comments (lines 253-322); Dec 2022 follow-up (367-375); Sep 2026 beta report and issue relationships (395-447).
sources.observed_operation: Read-only open of public GitHub issue and comments. No issue attachment, binary or generator was downloaded/run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Original report says STEP imported into 2.5.0 had 127 open edges and missing hinge/conical features while a comparison STL worked. A maintainer attributed importer quality to OpenCASCADE. A later Sep 2026 report says the same Owl STEP case reproduced using the then-current Flathub beta, fresh MK3S profile and default STEP settings, but gives no exact build. The issue has no linked branch/PR in the current record.
sources.applicability: Reported behavior, not an independently reproduced product test. The latest report raises a current-beta signal with an unknown build; it does not establish behavior in stable 2.9.6 or every STEP file.

sources.title: PrusaSlicer issue #15545: 3MF non-millimetre transform translations
sources.version_or_commit: Issue opened 2026-07-28; reproducer identifies PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 Windows x64 portable, SHA-256 7fd50b52d1cc3da87dbcb71e45e764412dd45688bea028f351333e86d9769704. Closed after inactivity on 2026-09-29; no fix/PR linked.
sources.locator: Minimal reproduction, expected/actual bounds and tested build (lines 158-223); close activity (lines 243-267).
sources.observed_operation: Read-only open of the official GitHub issue; did not download the reproducer or run the app.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Reporter describes mesh vertices converted to mm while build-item/component translation terms from an inch model are not; translated geometry can be off-plate. The issue closes after an inactivity warning, not a documented repair.
sources.applicability: Specific reported 2.9.6 behavior, not independent verification or a claim about later builds; useful unit/transform sentinel.
